params.body:
A fleet read on 2026-11-09 found 75 open tasks, and 32 of them came from rules that fire on something nobody can or needs to act on. A list that is mostly noise stops being read, and then the real task drowns too. This PR changes those rules in Elixir. A companion Portal PR (uptime grading, folding, parked reopen, staging wipe) reads what this one emits.

## What changes

**One cause, one task (`follows`).** Registry entries can now name the thresholds they follow from. After judging, `Judges` marks a verdict with `follows: <PARENT>` when that parent fired in the same measurement at the same urgency or worse. A week never folds into a month, so folding can't hide urgency.
- `TAGS_MISSING` follows `SEO_WEAK`.
- `SCORE_FAIR`, `SCORE_POOR`, `PAGE_HEAVY` and `SAVINGS_LARGE` follow `LCP_POOR`, then `LCP_FAIR`.
- `MAIL_FRAGILE` follows `MAIL_SPF_MISSING`.
- `CONSENT_LEAKING`, `CONSENT_MODE_MISSING` and `THIRD_PARTY_EARLY` follow `CONSENT_BANNER_MISSING`.

**Gated apps.** `gated` was parsed in Project.php, but no scan read it. In a gated project, Pages now treats a page that redirects to another path on the same site as behind the login, and treats the page it lands on as the sign-in screen. With nothing public left, the measurement is not applicable instead of failing. GLK signs in with a PIN and has no password field, so its sign-in screen counted three times as a page without a description.

**noindex out of basic tags.** A page that asks to stay out of search no longer takes a penalty point for asking. It no longer counts in `basistagsScore`, `tagGaps` or `extraGaps` either. `noindexPages` is still counted.

**Queue total is background.** `QUEUE_FAILING` counts from the first failure the app ever kept, and the count never drops. Stocklist carried a task for 1676 failures with 0 that day. `QUEUE_FAILED_TODAY` stays the week task. The weekly finding now names the last day only.

**Credentials prove themselves in a fortnight, not a day.** `CREDENTIAL_PROOF_STALE` goes from 24 to 336 hours. Keys that answered that same week still read "unproven".

**Search clicks need a base.** `SEARCH_CLICKS_COMPARABLE` (200 clicks in the previous window) is a registry value. Below it, `clicksDeltaPct` is absent, so no verdict fires. 37 clicks becoming 21 is a few visitors either way.

**Basic auth is locked, not down.** A 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Basic` sets `locked: 1`, and the new `IS_LOCKED` (ok) is tried first on the `reachable` facet. The minute watch and the flip history use the same rule (`Site::answers`). A 401 without that challenge is unchanged.

**Uptime thresholds in the registry.** `UPTIME_OK` (field `uptime30Pct`, >= 99.9, ok), `UPTIME_SLIPPING` (< 99.5, month) and `UPTIME_POOR` (< 99, week). Between 99.5 and 99.9 nothing fires, on purpose. Portal held these numbers in PHP, and there one missed check was a task.

**elixir.json environments are complete when declared.** `Project::fromPortal` used `$declared->staging ?: $p['staging']`, so a repo could not say "no staging". Naviskore removed its staging on 25 October, and Elixir kept measuring it through the Portal link. Now a file with `environments` is the whole topology. A file without `environments`, or without elixir.json at all, still falls back to Portal.

**A gone staging is sent as `staging: null`.** elixirData is posted with `merge: true`, and Portal's `array_replace` keeps keys that are not sent. So the last reading of a vanished staging stayed forever. Elixir now sends null once a previous staging exists and the topology has none. With `array_replace` that already overwrites the stale section.

**Domain naming.** `domaincontrol.com` nameservers are named GoDaddy instead of the bare nameserver domain.

## Who loses a staging with the elixir.json change

Every elixir.json under the checked-out repos that declares a staging is checked against what the fleet measures. The two stagings measured today, gentells (gentells-site) and sportbusinessgame (good-governance), are both declared. No watched project loses an environment it still has. Naviskore loses the Portal-only staging, which is the point.

## Interface for Portal

- A verdict may carry `follows` (a threshold name of another firing verdict in the same measurement). Fold it into that one and keep its reason as evidence.
- New thresholds: `IS_LOCKED`, `UPTIME_OK`, `UPTIME_SLIPPING`, `UPTIME_POOR`, `SEARCH_CLICKS_COMPARABLE`. `follows` is a new optional registry key, a list.
- `elixirData.payload.staging` may be `null`, meaning there is no staging.

## Checks

Pint, PHPStan (level 5) and `php artisan test`: 761 passed. The new tests are in `tests/Feature/OneCauseOneTaskTest.php`, with additions in Pages, Search, Declaration, OmgevingBewaart, Credentials and AppHealth.

## Order

Safe to merge first. Portal ignores the new `follows` key until its PR lands, so tasks stay as they are until then, except where this PR stops a verdict outright: the queue total, credentials, search, basic auth, gated pages and noindex.
params.title: Stop raising verdicts nobody can act on
